name: claude-mods

plugins.name: render-progress
plugins.description: A pacman-style progress bar above the prompt for long renders (Remotion, Lambda, Blender or any command), with alerts when one finishes, fails or stalls.

plugins.name: machine-monitor
plugins.description: A status line with load, GPU, swap and free disk; holds back heavy jobs while the machine is overloaded and warns when disk or temp folders cross a limit.

plugins.name: publish-schedule
plugins.description: A pane of today's and tomorrow's uploads (films, Shorts, other platforms) with what is due, overdue or done, and a reminder above the prompt within the hour.

plugins.name: channel-stats
plugins.description: YouTube subscribers and views for your channels in the status line, against the 1,000-subscriber Partner Program bar, with a daily change table.

plugins.name: command-guard
plugins.description: Turns your 'never run this' rules into a guard every Claude session obeys: matching commands are refused with your reason and what to do instead.

description: Mods for Claude Code, grouped by use: rendering, monitoring, YouTube and safety.
